title: Idealista Property Search Scraper
description: Search Idealista listings with prices, size, rooms, photos, location, and links. Batch location searches and page through property results across supported European markets.

country.title: Country
country.description: Market: es, it, pt, or fr. Default es.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: sale or rent. Room stock uses bedrooms + rent.

property_type.title: Property Type
property_type.description: homes, newDevelopments, bedrooms, offices, premises, transfers, buildings, storageRooms, garages, vacationRentals, luxury, or lands.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: Radius in meters when using center.

order.title: Order
order.description: Sort direction or ordering mode for property results.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Listing sort mode, such as price or publication date.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Filter results by listing quality when supported.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: Filter for listings that include gallery photos.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language and regional formatting for the listing search.

microsite_short_name.title: Microsite Short Name
microsite_short_name.description: Anonymous agency stock filter, for example clikalia.

chalet.title: Chalet
chalet.description: Apply-filter key. Send true on homes.

current_occupation_type.title: Current Occupation Type
current_occupation_type.description: free, bareOwnership, tenanted, illegallyOccupied, or viager.

home_type.title: Home Type
home_type.description: Idealista home subtype, such as an apartment or house.

bank_offer.title: Bank Offer
bank_offer.description: Filter listings associated with a bank offer.

min_price.title: Min Price
min_price.description: Minimum asking price for a property listing.

max_price.title: Max Price
max_price.description: Maximum asking price for a property listing.

min_size.title: Min Size
min_size.description: Minimum property area in square metres.

max_size.title: Max Size
max_size.description: Maximum property area in square metres.

min_rooms.title: Min Rooms
min_rooms.description: Minimum room count for a property listing.

max_rooms.title: Max Rooms
max_rooms.description: Maximum room count for a property listing.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Geographic search shape used to restrict Idealista results.
